citations.quote: We will not pay for loss due to and confined to wear and tear, freezing, mechanical or electrical breakdown or failure, or road damage to tires, unless the damage results from the total theft of your covered auto.

output.reasoning: The claim describes an electrical short in the engine bay as the source of the fire. Clause [EXC-1] explicitly excludes coverage for loss due to mechanical or electrical breakdown or failure. Because the damage is confined to the result of this electrical failure, the claim is excluded.
